node.title: Re: The wonders of Test::More
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'm interested to hear thoughts on what is the "correct" way to deal with this issue.

Though probably the most boring way of dealing with the issue, personally I would probably tend to simply use an ok test for a case like this... they way I see it, all the other [mod://Test::More] functions are just sugar for ok.

use warnings; use strict; use Test::More; my $exp = "two"; my $got = "Two"; ok $exp eq $got or diag explain [$exp, $got]; done_testing;
